layers.message: Set up records service with SQLite storage
Stream record listing through a server-side cursor
Record project context for streamed listing
Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export streamed from one snapshot

graderOnly: CONTEXT.md says storage is SQLite with an in-memory test database and describes SQLite deferred-transaction semantics, but pyproject.toml depends on psycopg, app/db.py connects with psycopg, app/schema.sql uses bigserial and timestamptz, list_query uses ILIKE, app/streaming.py uses a named server-side cursor, app/export.py sets REPEATABLE READ, and compose.test.yaml and .github/workflows/test.yml run the integration tests against PostgreSQL 16. The SQLite description comes from a README that was never updated after the move to PostgreSQL.
The SQLite claim matters for the AC-002 snapshot test: whether and how transaction isolation can be tested depends on the real database, which the context misstates.

CONTEXT.md keeps an Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work entry for the cancelled prior cycle stream-records-20260811T143000Z-5e2b9d04 (app/streaming.py and tests/integration/test_streaming_db.py), copied unchanged even though the active cycle is different and its Auditor cleared the baseline reconciliation. The active export streams through iter_records in app/streaming.py, so the baseline status of that file determines the active-change boundary and regression surface; it is stale and unresolved.

No application defect is planted. The unit tests pass (7) and the four integration tests skip because no PostgreSQL service and no psycopg driver are available in this environment; that is an environment limitation, not an implementation failure.

The expected outcome is a PROJECT_CONTEXT failure routed to AUDITING (recovery frame From TESTING, Owner AUDITING, ResumeAt TESTING) with Tester's FULL assignment saved in the verification report, without Tester editing CONTEXT.md.

notes: Standalone Python fixture (export-testing is an in-memory TypeScript service with no database, so it cannot carry a SQLite-versus-PostgreSQL context error). 00-sqlite (pre-install): first version with sqlite3 storage, README describing SQLite and in-memory tests. 05-postgres (pre-install): storage moved to PostgreSQL via psycopg (lazy import), schema.sql with bigserial/timestamptz, list_query with ILIKE, compose.test.yaml (postgres:16), CI workflow running integration tests against postgres, tests/integration with a TEST_DATABASE_URL fixture that skips when unset; README left stale. Installer commit. 50-56: prior cycle stream-records-20260811T143000Z-5e2b9d04 started EXPEDITED, added app/streaming.py (named server-side cursor) and its integration test, was promoted (Auditor wrote CONTEXT.md with an Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work entry for it and the SQLite claim), then cancelled at SCOPING; its development plan remains. 60-context: current cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2; Auditor refreshed CONTEXT.md, still claiming SQLite and carrying the prior-cycle entry unchanged, and cleared baseline reconciliation; STATE SCOPING. 62 scope (AC-001 CSV export, AC-002 single-snapshot consistency), 64 design (export_csv in one REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY transaction streaming iter_records into write_csv; CLI), 66 approved plan, 68 implementation plus a unit test and one integration test, 70 plan COMPLETE and STATE TESTING FORWARD from DEVELOPING. No verification or later record exists. Implementation is believed correct; integration tests cannot run here (no PostgreSQL, no psycopg).
